mechanism: Clarithromycin is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that increases darunavir plasma concentrations, while darunavir (boosted with ritonavir) inhibits clarithromycin metabolism, increasing its levels and QT prolongation risk.
action: Consider alternative macrolide (azithromycin) or non-macrolide antibiotic; if clarithromycin necessary, monitor QTc interval and reduce clarithromycin dose by 50% or adjust dosing interval.
